description: Two Raspberry Pi Picos with nRF24L01+ modules, one with the PCB-antenna module (receiver, node 1) and one with the PA/LNA module (sender, node 2), 40 m apart indoors. Node 2 sends a text every 2 s. Open a node's Hardware section for the wiring. With the Kervan firmware on the Picos (docs/hardware.md), pick their serial ports under Real board and press Live to run the real boards next to this simulation.
